title: Grade Supplement on Booked Days: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program 2026-27 Schedule
content:
The board-approved 2026-27 booked-day fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program adds a grade supplement to a booked day. The grade read is the one on the student's district enrollment record in Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions for the enrollment's school year, in status enrolled.

| Grade on that district enrollment record | Grade supplement |
|---|---|
| PK3 or PK4 | 6.00 |
| KG | 4.00 |
| 01, 02, 03, 04 or 05 | nothing |
| no such record (no district enrollment record for the school year in status enrolled) | nothing |

## Points of judgement

- The record must be for the same school year as the Creek Kids Club enrollment and in status enrolled. A record that shows another status leaves the student with no such record, and no supplement applies.
- The grade comes from the district enrollment record, not from the plan held. A PK4 student is supplemented 6.00 and a kindergartner 4.00.

## Examples (hypothetical students)

| District enrollment record for the school year | Supplement |
|---|---|
| enrolled, grade PK3 | 6.00 |
| enrolled, grade KG | 4.00 |
| enrolled, grade 02 | nothing |
